name: Dino Experience Porto
description: Travel back in time and walk among the dinosaurs. This immersive experience at the Alfândega is a huge hit with kids, featuring life-sized animatronics and interactive displays.
longDescription:
Dino Experience Porto is a large-scale, temporary exhibition dedicated to prehistoric life, specifically dinosaurs. The event features a collection of animatronic dinosaur models, designed to replicate the appearance and movement of various species. It is presented as an educational and entertaining attraction for a general audience, with a focus on engaging younger visitors with scientific concepts related to palaeontology.

Visitors to the Dino Experience Porto can expect to encounter a series of detailed dinosaur recreations within the historic setting of the Alfândega do Porto. The exhibition is structured to allow for exploration and observation of the displays, which include information panels alongside the models. The experience is designed to be accessible to families and children, offering an immersive environment for learning about dinosaurs.

Admission to Dino Experience Porto on 2026-08-27 is ticketed. The Alfândega do Porto is located on the riverside, accessible via bus lines 500 and 901, and is a walkable distance from the Ribeira district. The venue is known for its spacious exhibition halls.
